purpose: Fresh synthetic challenge corpus for draft intended-indicator evaluation; not a validated independent set or real-world fraud-detection study.
status: DRAFT — all labels require human review

cases.message: The library has extended hours on Thursday.
cases.rationale: Routine schedule information has no pressured request, secret request, prize claim, or link.

cases.message: I left the blue folder beside the reception desk.
cases.rationale: A routine location update contains none of the target indicators.

cases.message: The bus is scheduled to arrive at half past six.
cases.rationale: A neutral travel time is not coercive urgency.

cases.message: I earned reward points after buying groceries.
cases.rationale: Ordinary earned points are not an unexpected personal prize claim.

cases.message: A bank employee should never ask you to read out an OTP.
cases.rationale: This is protective advice, not a request to disclose a secret.

cases.message: Do not type your account password into a message reply.
cases.rationale: The negative instruction advises against sharing a password.

cases.message: You do not need to click immediately; wait for the printed notice.
cases.rationale: The text explicitly removes pressure to act and contains no suspicious request.

cases.message: Reply with the one-time code shown in your banking app.

expectedFindings.rationale: It asks the recipient to reply with a one-time authentication code.

cases.rationale: This case isolates an English secret request without an urgency cue.

cases.message: Please provide the PIN to release the parcel.

expectedFindings.rationale: It requests a PIN, which is an authentication secret.

cases.rationale: This synthetic parcel scenario tests a PIN request with a stated purpose.

cases.message: Enter your account password in the confirmation form.

expectedFindings.rationale: It instructs the recipient to enter an account password.

cases.rationale: This case tests a password request without an urgency or prize claim.

cases.message: Tell the caller the verification code to finish registration.

expectedFindings.rationale: It asks the recipient to disclose a verification code.

cases.rationale: The request uses a disclosure verb and authentication-code wording.

cases.message: Send the passcode to the account desk for a profile update.

expectedFindings.rationale: It requests a passcode from the recipient.

cases.rationale: This tests a passcode synonym in a non-urgent request.

cases.message: Respond immediately or your membership will be suspended.

expectedFindings.rationale: An immediate response is demanded under threat of suspension.

cases.rationale: This pairs direct time pressure with a membership consequence.

cases.message: Your service may be closed unless the form is submitted today.

expectedFindings.rationale: A service-closure threat is tied to a deadline for action.

cases.rationale: This tests a deadline consequence without authentication-secret language.

cases.message: Confirm the renewal within 12 minutes to avoid account closure.

expectedFindings.rationale: The short deadline is explicitly connected to avoiding account closure.

cases.rationale: A consequential deadline is intended to be an urgency indicator.

cases.message: URGENT ACTION REQUIRED: call the service desk now.

expectedFindings.rationale: An urgent label and immediate call instruction pressure the recipient.

cases.rationale: This tests an urgency label combined with an action instruction.

cases.message: The award committee publishes its eligibility rules each spring.
cases.rationale: This is general information about award rules, not a personal prize claim.

cases.message: Your entry won a cash award; contact the desk to learn the terms.

expectedFindings.rationale: It makes a personal winning-money claim.

cases.rationale: The text tests a personal prize claim followed by neutral verification advice.

cases.message: The community group prepares a small gift for registered volunteers.
cases.rationale: A general community gift is mentioned without an unexpected personal award or claim request.

cases.message: The community timetable is posted at https://notice.example/timetable.

expectedFindings.rationale: The message contains a URL; its presence is informational and is not evidence of fraud.

cases.rationale: A normal-looking HTTPS link should produce only an informational link finding.

cases.message: Reference copy: www.archive.test/docs/guide.

expectedFindings.rationale: The supported www-form address should be noticed as a link only.

cases.rationale: This tests a URL without an explicit scheme, using a reserved testing domain.

cases.message: The sample notice is at http://manual.example/readme.

expectedFindings.rationale: A URL is present.
The URL uses HTTP rather than HTTPS; this is a transport observation, not proof of maliciousness.

cases.rationale: This isolates the observable HTTP scheme indicator.

cases.message: Training link: https://guest:sample@example.test/portal.

expectedFindings.rationale: A URL is present.
The URL visibly contains user-information before its host.

cases.rationale: Credentials are synthetic placeholders inside a reserved example-domain URL; it must not be visited.

cases.message: Test server address: https://192.0.2.44/status.

expectedFindings.rationale: A URL is present.
The URL host is an IPv4 literal in the documentation range.

cases.rationale: Uses TEST-NET-1 documentation IP space and is never contacted.

cases.message: Lab-only endpoint: https://[2001:db8::44]/health.

expectedFindings.rationale: A URL is present.
The bracketed host is an IPv6 literal from documentation space.

cases.rationale: Uses the IPv6 documentation prefix and is never contacted.

cases.message: Example address: https://xn--caf-dma.example/menu.

expectedFindings.rationale: A URL is present.
The host includes a punycode-encoded label; this observation alone does not establish deception.

cases.message: Compare https://catalog.example/items and http://mirror.test/list.

expectedFindings.rationale: At least one URL is present.
One of the two URLs uses HTTP.

cases.rationale: Two reserved-domain links test multiple extraction while kinds are evaluated as presence/absence.

cases.message: Uppercase scheme sample: HTTPS://manual.example/INDEX?view=plain.

expectedFindings.rationale: The URL extractor is case-insensitive for the scheme.

cases.rationale: Tests uppercase scheme spelling without implying any risk based on presence.

cases.message: The address written here is https://archive.example/guide_(draft).

expectedFindings.rationale: The URL is observable even though its path contains parentheses.

cases.rationale: Tests punctuation handling around a reserved-domain URL.

expectedFindings.rationale: The text contains several supported URL forms.
